## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`flows.mdx` 中「`org:members` 找不到组织时谁也通知不到」一句改为按租户姿态分别说明:`single` 下谁也不通知、服务端日志告警、步骤成功;`group` 下通知写入被拒(`ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED`)、步骤失败;`isolated` 下这种定时流根本不会启用。补一句补救办法:声明流的执行组织。
- 为什么改:原句只在 `single` 下成立;`group` 下作者按文档预期「静默成功」,实际会看到步骤失败。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档一段文字,不碰任何包、不发布;回滚即还原该段。
- 先看:`content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` 第 343–356 行这一段。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`,应只见这一段改动,三种姿态各一句。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One paragraph of `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` (§ notify recipients). The old sentence said that where a notification has no organization, `org:members` reaches nobody with a server-log warning. That holds under the `single` posture only. The paragraph now names the posture:

- **`single`**: `org:members` reaches nobody, with a server-log warning, and the step succeeds.
- **`group`**: the notification write itself is refused (`ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED`) and the step fails.
- **`isolated`**: a `schedule` flow that declares no `organization` is never armed.
- Remedy: declare the flow's acting organization (start-node `config.organization`), linked to the page's own `#the-acting-organization` section.

The "any other `org:` value is no selector and reaches nobody, with a warning" half is kept and is now stated on its own, since it does not depend on the posture.

### Each claim, read on `main` @ 6e287974

| Claim | Code |
|:--|:--|
| The run with no organization is a `schedule` flow with no declared `organization` and no record | `packages/triggers/trigger-schedule/src/schedule-trigger.ts:552` (`describeScheduleRunOwnership`: a plain `schedule` flow sweeps no records, so under per-record ownership it carries none); `packages/spec/src/automation/schedule-organization.zod.ts:49-54` (posture table) |
| The notify node passes the run's organization, else the record's, else none | `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts:1213` (`context.tenantId`), `:1230-1240` (`organizationOfRecordAbout`) |
| `emit()` writes the event row before it resolves the audience | `packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service.ts:1398` (`writeEvent`), then `:1419` (`resolver.resolve` with the producer's `organizationId`) |
| `single`: the event row is owned by the sole organization, the audience gets none, nobody is reached, warning logged, step succeeds | `packages/core/src/security/system-write-organization.ts:115-125` (`derived` at exactly one organization under `single`); `messaging-service.ts:1419-1425` (resolver gets `input.organizationId`, 0 recipients warns and returns); `packages/services/service-messaging/src/recipient-resolver.ts:232-239` (`org:members` with no organization warns, 0 recipients); `notify-node.ts:1307` (`success: true`) |
| `group`: the write is refused and the step fails | `system-write-organization.ts:115` (any posture but `single` is `refuse` / `walled-posture`); `schedule-organization.zod.ts:103-105` (a record-less undeclared run under `group` takes the `walled-posture` refusal at the write); `notify-node.ts:1385-1394` (the catch returns `success: false`, `notify failed: ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED: …`) |
| `isolated`: such a flow is never armed | `schedule-trigger.ts:804` (`policy.requiresActingOrganization && organization === null` releases and throws at bind); `schedule-organization.zod.ts:54` |

### Agreement with PR #33577 (the skill twin)

PR #33577 (head 7cc0ff03) teaches in `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`: "else nobody (`single` posture: a `schedule` flow declaring no `organization`, no record). Any other `org:` value reaches nobody too. Each warns in the server log only; the node succeeds." This paragraph says the same for `single`, and adds `group` and `isolated`, which the skill line does not cover. No disagreement. If the server lane ever passes the resolver the organization stamped on the event row (the `owned` value at `messaging-service.ts:1399-1401`) instead of the producer's, both texts move together; the card names this.
